name: Rear-drive V8 coupe
notes: A front-engined rear-drive coupe with a manual six: 1700 kg, 54 % on the front, sport tyres, a clutch-pack limited-slip rear differential (80 N m of preload, a torque bias of 0.25), independent rear suspension. The numbers are a typical V8 coupe's, not one model's. The car part of a build: pair it with an engine of some 5 L.
